goal: One DO assistant across browser, native, mobile and hosted Pursuit/Studio: permissioned vision, reasoning, focused TypeSafe decisions, durable scoped records and specifically approved actions with verified receipts.

workstreams.done_when: A signed-in allowlisted run returns an actual provider response with redacted evidence.
Existing DO draft preparation runs from the new opt-in bridge and passes full-app and live preview verification.
Every inventoried supported surface authenticates, revokes and resumes one owner/workspace-scoped job.
User-selected captures produce reviewable multimodal observations and useful plans with consent, provenance and stale-context checks.
Versioned records save/reopen after restart with tenant isolation, retention and conflict handling.
The actual private hub opens the same authenticated durable job and records; link-only integration is insufficient.
Payload-bound approvals, idempotency and provider/database verification prove exact authorised transactions.
All target surfaces pass accessible runtime, adversarial and recovery tests with measured budgets and rollback.

global_boundaries: No unattended consequential actions from this goal alone
No saved/sent/published label without observed backing evidence
